content:
**Purified Water** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

Purified Water is kept in a cylinder-shaped container bearing the words "Property U.S. Gov't" near the top, and "Emergency Drinking Water" down the middle, and was originally packaged by the MacDougal-Bernard Company in Boston. It can be used often to recover thirst when unable to use Boiled Water to make other drinks at a Cooking Station.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Dirty Water (1) Water Filter (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Known by default | | Purified Water (1) | 

Water purifiers will automatically produce purified water if powered in a camp. The rate of Purified Water production will vary with the size of the purifier constructed. Some purifier variants must be constructed in a body of water, however the smallest variant can be built on solid land.
